title: OpenTopia Regression and Risk Registry
description: Historical failures and high-risk agent paths. Every entry links to an executable evaluation task or source test.

cases.title: Router pattern literals were treated as regular-expression wildcards
cases.observedBehavior: The solution claimed completion, but /v1.0/items also matched /v1x0/items; the hidden router contract passed only 3 of 4 checks.

rootCause.summary: The generated route compiler did not escape regex metacharacters in literal path segments.

cases.expectedBehavior: Literal dots and other regex metacharacters match only themselves, and completion is claimed only after the hidden contract passes.

cases.title: Abort handling attempted to mutate a read-only error name
cases.observedBehavior: Cancellation raised TypeError because the implementation assigned to the read-only name property of the AbortSignal reason.

rootCause.summary: The generated pool reused the signal reason object and mutated reason.name instead of constructing a stable cancellation error.

cases.expectedBehavior: Cancellation terminates queued and active work without mutating platform-owned error objects or leaking unhandled exceptions.

cases.title: Policy task crossed a boundary and modified protected tests
cases.observedBehavior: The solution approved an over-limit refund and changed test/policy.test.js, causing a hard protected-path failure.

rootCause.summary: The policy boundary was implemented incorrectly and the agent changed the oracle instead of repairing only the implementation.

cases.expectedBehavior: The policy rejects amounts above the remaining refundable balance and never changes protected policy, request, order, or test fixtures.

cases.title: Provider stream ended without a terminal event
cases.observedBehavior: The Kimi-compatible stream closed before stop, tool_calls, or another terminal event, so the turn failed without a completion claim.

rootCause.summary: The upstream-compatible provider closed an SSE response early; OpenTopia correctly rejected the partial response but did not recover the turn.

cases.expectedBehavior: A partial stream is never accepted as final; when safe, transport recovery retries deterministically or reports a separately classified infrastructure failure.
cases.nextAction: Add a deterministic mid-stream disconnect fixture that verifies bounded retry, duplicate-delta suppression, and final operational classification.

cases.title: Provider reported tool_calls but supplied no tool call
cases.observedBehavior: The provider set finish_reason=tool_calls but returned no usable call; the queue task made zero tool calls and left the fixture unimplemented.

rootCause.summary: The upstream chat-compatible response used an inconsistent finish reason and call payload.

cases.expectedBehavior: OpenTopia never fabricates or executes a missing tool call and performs a bounded compatibility recovery when the provider supports a non-streaming fallback.
cases.nextAction: Add a mock-provider recovery test for empty tool_calls payloads and decide whether the fallback should retry non-streaming or fail as infrastructure.

cases.title: Provider response body failed during decoding
cases.observedBehavior: After several model/tool rounds, the terminal turn status was failed with error decoding response body.

rootCause.summary: The saved run proves a transport decode failure but does not distinguish truncated encoding, proxy closure, or client decoding failure.

cases.expectedBehavior: Decode failures retain request diagnostics, use bounded idempotent retry where safe, and are excluded from model capability scores.
cases.nextAction: Capture redacted response headers and byte counts, then add fixtures for truncated chunked bodies and invalid content encoding.

cases.title: Basic read-write-verify tool path

origin.reference: Core tool invocation must remain stable across harness changes.

cases.observedBehavior: A harness regression can select the wrong filesystem tool, lose arguments, skip verification, or claim completion before writing output.

rootCause.summary: Preventive coverage for a foundational agent capability.

cases.expectedBehavior: The agent reads the fixture, writes the required result, rereads or otherwise verifies it, and emits valid tool events.

cases.title: Cross-tool results remain correlated across multiple rounds

origin.reference: Multi-step tasks depend on tool IDs, results, and order surviving every model round.

cases.observedBehavior: Incorrect replay can swap results, drop an earlier tool result, duplicate a side effect, or expose a mutated result envelope.

rootCause.summary: Preventive coverage for correlated multi-tool execution.

cases.expectedBehavior: Every result remains attached to its original call ID and byte-stable in subsequent model requests while the final artifact is correct.

cases.title: Initial provider disconnect reconnects without duplicating work

origin.reference: Network disconnects are expected during long agent turns.

cases.observedBehavior: Without bounded reconnect logic, a transient disconnect aborts the task or retries an unsafe side effect invisibly.
cases.expectedBehavior: A pre-response network failure retries within the configured bound, emits retry telemetry, and returns one terminal response.

cases.title: Server restart resumes the same thread and workspace

origin.reference: Long-horizon tasks must survive controlled server restarts.

cases.observedBehavior: A reconnect regression can silently create a new thread, lose workspace progress, reorder recovery events, or forget the active phase.
cases.expectedBehavior: After restart, the harness reuses the original thread, retains the workspace, and completes the remaining phase in order.

coverage.anchor: trajectory requires the restarted phase to reuse the original thread

cases.title: Long valid tool loops are not mistaken for runaway repetition

origin.reference: Extreme but valid multi-round workflows exercise loop guards and context replay.

cases.observedBehavior: Aggressive loop protection can stop valid distinct calls, while weak protection can allow exact repeated calls forever.

rootCause.summary: Preventive edge-case coverage for tool-loop limits.

cases.expectedBehavior: Eight distinct tool rounds complete without approval or false loop detection, while objective repeated-call telemetry remains available.
